title: fix(langchain): report finish_reason from OpenAI and Anthropic response metadata

files.patch:
@@ -99,10 +99,15 @@ def _transform_output(self, response: LCModelResponse) -> ChatModelOutput:
         message = response["output"]
         usage_metadata: dict[str, Any] = getattr(message, "usage_metadata", None) or {}
         input_token_details: dict[str, int] = usage_metadata.get("input_token_details") or {}
+        response_metadata: dict[str, Any] = message.response_metadata or {}
         return ChatModelOutput(
             output=to_beeai_messages([message]),
             output_structured=response["output_structured"],
-            finish_reason=message.response_metadata.get("done_reason"),
+            # Ollama reports "done_reason", OpenAI "finish_reason", Anthropic "stop_reason", Bedrock "stopReason".
+            finish_reason=response_metadata.get("done_reason")
+            or response_metadata.get("finish_reason")
+            or response_metadata.get("stop_reason")
+            or response_metadata.get("stopReason"),
             usage=ChatModelUsage(
                 prompt_tokens=usage_metadata.get("input_tokens") or 0,
                 completion_tokens=usage_metadata.get("output_tokens") or 0,

@@ -130,3 +130,23 @@ def test_transform_output_without_token_details_has_no_cached_tokens() -> None:
     assert output.usage is not None
     assert output.usage.cached_prompt_tokens == 0
     assert output.usage.cached_creation_tokens == 0
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("response_metadata", "expected"),
+    [
+        ({"done_reason": "stop"}, "stop"),
+        ({"finish_reason": "tool_calls"}, "tool_calls"),
+        ({"stop_reason": "max_tokens"}, "max_tokens"),
+        ({"stopReason": "end_turn"}, "end_turn"),
+        ({}, None),
+    ],
+)
+def test_transform_output_reports_the_finish_reason(response_metadata: dict[str, str], expected: str | None) -> None:
+    model = LangChainChatModel(GenericFakeChatModel(messages=iter([])))
+    message = AIMessage(content="hi", response_metadata=response_metadata)
+
+    output = model._transform_output({"output": message, "output_structured": None})  # type: ignore[typeddict-item]
+
+    assert output.finish_reason == expected
